verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical and share the same failures. The brand mark is shrunk to a tiny logo beside a thumbnail-sized can, and the long headline is jammed at the very top above it. The CTA sits above the body copy it should follow, which breaks reading order. The SUNSET SALE ribbon is blown up into a big diagonal slab dumped mid-column among the badges, competing with the CTA for attention. The three badges are scattered: one is plain text, two are pills, with the ribbon wedged between them. The broken missing-image placeholder is still there at the bottom left, and the legal text is cramped.
